chunks: Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Khalaf ibn Hammad, who said:

I sent a message to Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him): 'What is the lowest term for Mut'ah? Is it allowed for a man to perform Mut'ah with a stipulation of (copulating) once?' He (peace be upon him) said: 'Yes'.
ai.seo_question: What is the minimum duration required for a valid temporary marriage (Mut'ah) contract in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) confirms the permissibility of a minimal duration for Mut'ah, specifically validating a contract stipulating a single sexual act as sufficient. This establishes the principle that the term need not be fixed to a day or month, but can be as brief as the act itself, reflecting the flexibility of the contract in Shia jurisprudence. The dialogue highlights the Imam's direct authority in clarifying legal minutiae regarding the essential conditions of temporary marriage.

en.hubeali: Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Khalaf Bin Hammad who said,
‘I sent a message to Abu Al-Hassanasws, ‘How much is the lowest term for the Mut’a. Is it allowed if the man does Mut’a with a stipulation of (copulating) once?’ Heasws said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Khalid from Khalaf ibn Hammad who has said the following:

“I once sent (a message) to abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and asked, ‘How much is the minimum duration of time in al-Mut‘ah (advantageous marriage) and if it is permissible to set the time for only one time going to bed. He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is permissible.’”
